{{Conjecture|legends}}
The inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] instigated an '''uprising''' against the occupying [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sometime after the planet was [[Battle of Sullust (Great Galactic War)|captured]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Xerxian]] failed to put down the uprising, causing him to be summoned to speak with [[Darth Marr]].
